summary: This clinical study compares two weight-loss drugs, an experimental drug called HDM1702 and WEGOVY, in patients with obesity. The trial is currently Recruiting and has a target enrollment of 460 participants. Researchers want to see how well the treatments work and track safety over 48 weeks. All participants will receive lifestyle counseling on diet and physical activity during the study.
